title: FoxbridgeMC: Fabric's Desires FPS Enhanced
description:
Welcome to FoxbridgeMC: Fabric's Desires FPS Enhanced
This pack is an optional pack that adds mods to enhance your fps in game. it contains the same core mods as the original one.
body:
Welcome to **FoxbridgeMC: Fabric's Desires FPS Enhanced**\
This pack is an Official Addon to [The Original Pack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/foxmcfd)

The Main additions to this pack compared to **FoxbridgeMC: Fabric's Desires** are ;
- Clumps
- EMI
- Jade
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Indium
- Zoomify
- Mod Menu
- Freecam (Modrinth Edition)

These mods are here to gain FPS as well as some Quality Of Life Improvements, such as freecam, mod menu, jade and EMI. Because we consider those mods as a must have for a good modded experience !
